A [[merchant]] is an [[NPC]] that buys and sell [[item]]s, such as identification and salvage [[kit]]s, as well as more exotic commodities, such as [[sweet]]s or [[alcohol]]. Merchants will also sell the applicable [[key]] for the region they are located in. Unlike [[trader]]s, merchants sell their wares at fixed prices, which do not vary according to supply and demand. Usually, a merchant will charge double the item's value. For example, [[Vial of Dye|Vial of Dye [Gray]]] would cost 50 [[Image:Gold.gif|Gold]] at the merchant, while it can be sold back for 25 [[Image:Gold.gif|Gold]]. In [[Factions]], there are [[Faction merchant]]s that will only provide services to certain players in [[outpost]]s and under certain circumstances in [[explorable area]]s.

Only certain items can be sold to merchants, [[armorer]]s, [[artisan]]s or [[weaponsmith]]s:
*Items that can be bought from merchants. 
*Items that can also be sold to [[trader]]s.
*[[Roleplaying character]] [[armor]] (except the armor that comes equipped on a newly-created roleplaying character).
*[[Weapon]]s that can be [[salvage]]d for [[crafting material]]s (except [[Gift of the Traveler#Weapons|rare weapons from Gifts of the Traveler]] and [[:Category:Envoy weapons|Envoy weapons]]), [[unique item]]s that are [[drop]]ped by a [[foe]], and [[Item rarity|blue]] [[collector weapon]]s.
*[[Salvage item]]s and [[Trophy|trophies]].
*[[Aged Dwarven Ale]], [[Bottle of Juniberry Gin]], [[Bottle of Vabbian Wine]], and [[Hunter's Ale]].
*[[Kilnn Testibrie's Greaves]], [[Kilnn Testibrie's Crest|Crest]], [[Kilnn Testibrie's Cuisse|Cuisse]] and [[Kilnn Testibrie's Pauldron|Pauldron]] quest items.

== Notes ==
* Merchants can normally be identified by the word [Merchant] after their name.
* In explorable areas, a [[Merchant (summon)|Merchant ally]] can be summoned by using a [[Mercantile Summoning Stone]], or [[the Purveyor]] can be summoned by using [[Purveyor's Bell]].
* Merchants are addressed in the [[Prophecies]] Manuscripts and by various Prophecies NPCs as "Outfitters".
{{bug| If you use a [[tonic]] while browsing a merchant's inventory, you will not be able to sell or buy anything unless you close and reopen it.}}
